response.original_title: 【Step-by-Step™-Guide】 How to communicate on MSC Cruise?
response.overview: You can communicate on an MSC cruise using the free internal chat on the MSC for Me App, calling via stateroom phones, or purchasing an internet package.  Onboard Communication Methods MSC for Me App: Download the app before boarding and connect to the ship's Wi-Fi network in airplane mode. The built-in chat feature lets you message other passengers onboard for free (available for guests 16 and older). Users on Cruise Critic generally agree that you connect by adding contacts via name, cabin number, or scanning a QR code. Stateroom Telephones: Call directly between cabins by dialing another room's telephone number +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK). Paid Wi-Fi Packages: Purchase an onboard internet package if you need to use standard messaging apps like WhatsApp or iMessage, check emails, or browse social media.
